agent_notes: GeoNames (via weather.us mirror) confirms 'Lakhor Chhoti' is a real populated place (GeoNames ID 10009714, 29.00074N/73.67697E) explicitly located in Bīkāner District, Lunkaransar tehsil, Rajasthan — this is the strongest confirmation found and matches the research unit's geo context exactly. No dedicated news article, video, social post, book, or gazetteer text mentioning 'Lakhor Chhoti' by name was found despite ~21 web searches across Hindi and English spellings and all channels (news, video, social, image, book/archive, gov). The Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Bikaner, archive.org full text) does not contain the name in the retrievable excerpt. Three Patrika (Bikaner) news features on Mahajan Field Firing Range displacement were found and read in full; none names this specific village among the ones it does list (Bhojrasar, Kumhana, Motlai, Khaniser, Thoiya, Manera, Duder, Khajuwala, Dantaur, Pugal, Mohangadh, Nachna), so they are recorded only as background/context sources, not direct hits. A 1987 Lok Sabha unstarred question (No. 4236, Sansad eLibrary) on 'Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan' likely contains an official village list in its attached PDF but the PDF body could not be read via WebFetch — this is the best next lead. Facebook/YouTube/Wikipedia/Jatland/indiankanoon searches returned nothing specific to this village; villageinfo.in and onefivenine.com direct-URL guesses for the village both failed (403/no data), so census/panchayat-level administrative detail (population, code) remains unfound.
